Then first check your Bluetooth connection, with another device ( air pod in example)
If ok stwich off your phone, wait 30 seconds and restart it ( time for Bluetooth re initializing Bluetooth)
If it is ok, done you get your alarms.
A second possibility is “low compression “: when sensor is compressed values fall a lot. At a moment sensor reacts and doesn’t give any value.
This is due to the location of the sensor, which cannot be compressed (I.e during night your arm must be free, so check the side you sleep and put the sensor on the other side.) sensor has to be placed at the rear of the arm).
Then compatibility with your phone, phone has to be in Abbott list…
